description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Impose Annual Levy, under Electricity Act. (20/2009)
reasoning: This gazette notification imposes an annual levy on electricity licensees under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009. It constitutes a regulatory action by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka, establishing compliance requirements and financial obligations for licensees in the electricity sector. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
